population.span: we assigned adults who had been admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU) for severe community-acquired pneumonia

endpoint.span: The primary outcome was death at 28 days.

estimate.span: 25 of 400 patients (6.2%; 95% confidence interval [CI], 3.9 to 8.6) in the hydrocortisone group and in 47 of 395 patients (11.9%; 95% CI, 8.7 to 15.1) in the placebo group (absolute difference, -5.6 percentage points; 95% CI, -9.6 to -1.7; P = 0.006).

ci.span: (absolute difference, -5.6 percentage points; 95% CI, -9.6 to -1.7; P = 0.006)

treatment_strategy.span: to receive intravenous hydrocortisone (200 mg daily for either 4 or 7 days as determined by clinical improvement, followed by tapering for a total of 8 or 14 days) or to receive placebo. All the patients received standard therapy, including antibiotics and supportive care.

follow_up.span: The primary outcome was death at 28 days.

absent_reason: {"analysis_set":"Sources state that 800 patients were randomized and 795 analyzed, but do not identify the analysis set as ITT, mITT, per-protocol, or another defined population."}
served_mismatch: The served arm counts match the source. However, they apply to day 28, not the specified 30-day or in-hospital timepoint. The served ITT label is unsupported by the held sources. The reported between-arm estimate and CI are an absolute risk difference in percentage points; no RR or RR CI is printed.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Adults admitted to an ICU for severe community-acquired pneumonia fall within adults hospitalized with community-acquired pneumonia; ITT status is not established.

notes: Bound the reported day-28 mortality RD and its CI, in percentage points, alongside the arm counts. No RR was calculated. Abstract evidence was used; registry corroborates all-cause mortality at day 28.
